prompt: Single continuous shot. Three ingredients in hard spotlight: ground beef, two carrots, sweet potatoes — one second still. Then motion: beef breaking apart in a hot pan, grated carrot vanishing into it in an orange flurry, sweet potato mashed into a vivid orange silk with butter folding through. Money shot: the orange purée spread over the beef in waves and dragged into peaks, then out of the oven — a spoon cracking through the caramelized top, lifting a two-layer cross-section, steam backlit. Final beat: the scoop on a plate. Warm light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the beef sizzle, then the crust crack. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption: Como prometido: o escondidinho acidental — purê de batata-doce por cima e a cenoura escondida no refogado. **Sábado que vem: [A] atum, ovo e batata ou [B] frango desfiado, milho e requeijão? Comenta A ou B 👇**
